tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch current price, stock and details for one Gameshop Enter product by its SKU (as returned by search_products). Includes the product-page URL (url) and a direct checkout link (checkoutUrl) that puts the item in the cart and opens checkout; with the buyer's country, url and local follow that count

tools.name: store_info
tools.description: Shipping costs and delivery times per country (EU and 191 non-EU destinations), free-shipping thresholds (EU only), customs rules outside the EU, 30-day return policy, payment methods, languages and the public profiles where Gameshop Enter can be verified.
